en:
## New Features

- Streaming blocks now preserve temporal arrival order — reasoning, web search, and text blocks render in the correct sequence instead of being grouped by type
- NarraForkAdmin agent tool allows admin users to read/write server settings through the AI narrator, with sensitive field masking and permission controls
- User role management: promote/demote users via clickable role badge with confirmation dialog and last-admin protection
- Reasoning block context menu (right-click on desktop, swipe on mobile) with copy, fork, compact, and delete actions; Ctrl/Cmd+Click and Shift+Click block selection
- Container build/start phase detection with color-coded phase badges during startup
- Container errors now persist as dismissible alerts with build logs retained after failure for easier diagnosis
- Docker Compose configuration for self-hosted deployment with named volume for data isolation

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed false positive ZSTD_CLI_MISSING errors during incremental updates — now uses explicit tracking instead of inferring from patch availability
- Fixed build script crash when rcodesign is not installed by adding proper error handling around binary detection
- Added retry button to zstd missing alert so users can retry after installing zstd without reopening the update modal
- MCP tool cards now use theme-aware borders instead of hardcoded dark background color
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 流式输出块现在按时间顺序渲染 — 推理、网络搜索和文本块按实际到达顺序显示，不再按类型分组
- NarraForkAdmin 代理工具：管理员可通过 AI 叙述者读写服务器设置，敏感字段自动脱敏，写操作需用户授权
- 用户角色管理：点击角色徽章即可提升/降级用户，带确认对话框和末位管理员保护
- 推理块右键菜单（桌面端右键，移动端滑动），支持复制、分叉、压缩、删除操作；支持 Ctrl/Cmd+点击和 Shift+点击多选
- 容器构建/启动阶段检测，启动过程中显示颜色编码的阶段徽章
- 容器启动失败后错误信息持久显示为可关闭的警告，构建日志保留以便排查
- 新增 Docker Compose 配置，支持自托管部署，使用命名卷隔离数据

## 修复

- 修复增量更新时 ZSTD_CLI_MISSING 误报问题 — 改用显式标志追踪，不再从 patch 可用性间接推断
- 修复未安装 rcodesign 时构建脚本崩溃的问题，添加了正确的异常处理
- zstd 缺失提示中增加重试按钮，安装 zstd 后无需重新打开更新弹窗
- MCP 工具卡片改用主题感知的边框样式，替代硬编码的深色背景
